remaining_cautions.evidence_context: The source reports OD600 growth curves and qualitative effects, not MIC/MBC/IC50 endpoint tables.
Figure 3 contains plotted time courses, but XML/PDF/supplement/database material does not provide exact numeric point tables.
The local primary/supplement/database material reviewed for this paper contains no hemolysis, mammalian cytotoxicity, or selectivity assay for P3/P10/P26.
APD6 AP03197 links P3 to the paper and qualitative activity, but assay type is Unknown and concentration/value fields are empty.
CPPpred is computational prioritization and Figure 3 is growth inhibition; no direct mode-of-action assay is reported.
